ownerStatement: Approved by repeat98 on 14 Oct 2026 (HANDOVER.md, owner decisions): release Mute Modes 0.2.1, not 0.2.0; the OT page screenshots may be kept from the previous versions.
reason: The owner approved this exact native source: Zac-Kyoti's 0.1.0 with its runtime package's fresh_bind detour replaced by an ev_voice_bind subscriber (order 50) that runs the same fresh_bind code, the SC_KEY variant replaced by a raise of the base's ev_mute_keep event once per frame in OTFX, OTFX-T and DT-T, and MUTE MODE restored from its battery copy on the first UI tick after an install; native builds, plain, SC_KEY and menu, assemble byte-identical to the author's references. The OT pages and controls are unchanged, so the 0.1.0 captures are retained. Evidence is emulator-only (synthetic mute/mode words, DSP records and a stand-in ev_mute_keep provider); physical audio, power-cycle persistence, current-build hardware, chip worst-case timing and complete memory bounds stay waived for this exact version only, and the author's historical hardware evidence stays historical. Native/browser parity, source-only reproduction and repository checks remain required; the release can only publish once a base built with site events that raises ev_mute_keep ships. 0.2.0 is not released. Re-bound on 14 Oct 2026 from 411613bd4e9a… to cover evidence/performance.json relabelled to 0.2.1-experimental with every measurement unmeasured (its earlier figures not carried over); the native code is unchanged, and the owner gave the go-ahead to ship the beta without hardware verification.
